name: Zhihu Content Pipeline
description: A Zhihu content-creation kit: five role characters (scout / editor / researcher / writer / polisher), six Zhihu writing and research skills, MCP presets for Exa, Fetch, Sequential Thinking and a CloakBrowser stealth browser, and the external zget CLI (run by the roles and the topic workflow) for Zhihu hot lists. Find hot topics, research, and draft a high-vote answer; drafts stay in the plugin's local store — nothing is posted to Zhihu.
author: cognia-next

permissionJustifications.session:write: Starts a Writer-character chat session seeded with the selected topic when you pick one in the /zhihu review panel.
permissionJustifications.agent:control: Contributes the five Zhihu role characters, six inline playbook skills, and four MCP server presets.
permissionJustifications.agent:dispatch: Contributes the 知乎写作小组 agent-team template (research → write → polish).
permissionJustifications.extension:workflow: Contributes the save-topics workflow node and the 知乎选题候选 daily workflow template.
permissionJustifications.extension:ui: Opens the /zhihu topic-review modal and links to Workflows from it.
permissionJustifications.session:read: Reopens the Writer session a saved draft came from when you choose “Open writing session” in the /zhihu review panel.
permissionJustifications.clipboard:write: Copies a saved draft to the clipboard as Markdown when you press Copy in the /zhihu review panel.

tools.name: zhihu_save_research
tools.description: 保存一条知乎调研笔记到流水线数据库（可引用的事实/数据/案例/来源）。供调研员使用。

kind.description: 笔记类型：fact | data | case | source 等

content.description: 笔记正文（提取出的事实/数据/案例）

tools.name: zhihu_save_draft
tools.description: 把一篇知乎回答终稿（Markdown + 配图）存为草稿到流水线数据库。供写手/润色师在终稿确认后使用。默认仅存草稿，不发布。

images.description: 配图文件路径或来源链接（可选）

browser.reason: Characters, skills, MCP presets, and the review modal load in the browser, but the daily topic workflow's terminal node (zget) and MCP server spawning need the Tauri desktop shell.

headless.reason: No renderer: the /zhihu modal, seeded-session UI handoff, and the terminal-node workflow cannot run; characters, skills, tools, and presets still contribute.

mobile.reason: Characters and skills load on mobile; the terminal-node workflow and MCP server spawning (zget / browser) need the desktop sidecar.
